lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We got the samples you wanted.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You did well. They're in pristine condition.
Are you going to be planting them in the garden?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We'll also be using them for some genetic crossbreeding.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: At the end of the day, Eden is located in the middle of a wasteland.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: In order to retain a semblance of biodiversity,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: we need to continually develop viable crops.
Sounds important.
I'd like to have a taste when they're done.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Extremely.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Thanks to you, we won't have to rely on Splendamin for every meal.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: If you're still here when we're finished, certainly.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You can sample as many as you like.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That reminds me.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Isabel said she wanted to continue working with you.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Are you okay with that?
I'm fine with it.
I haven't decided yet.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That's unexpected.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I thought it was another one of Isabel's delusions.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: At any rate,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I don't care, so long as the mission is accomplished.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That's what I thought.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Isabel,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: are you seeing this?
Isabel doesn't reply.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: What a pain in the neck.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: As you can see, all the Nikkes at Eden are like this.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'm sorry, but you'll need to go on another mission with her.
That's fine.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Get some rest in the meantime.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'll be in touch.
